claim_elements.name: Partitioned multi-agent evidence
claim_elements.description: A plurality of AI agents or processing nodes receives different evidence, context, or role-specific inputs.

claim_elements.description: A later stage receives, aggregates, verifies, or reaches consensus over the earlier outputs or pooled evidence.

claim_elements.name: Deterministic policy composition

claim_elements.name: Coalitional utility or contribution measurement
claim_elements.description: The system computes utility, superadditive surplus, marginal contribution, Shapley allocation, or coalition value.
